notes: CDER Office of Unapproved Drugs and Labeling Compliance website-review letter (no facility inspection): FDA lab-confirmed undeclared tadalafil/sildenafil in three named sexual-enhancement products, charged as unapproved new drugs (505(a)) and misbranded (502(a),(f)(1),(f)(2)). Footnotes mention other product lines (Titanium 18K, Hard AF, Rhino, Royal Honey) only as unsampled/untested concerns, not charged violations, so they are excluded from products. Footnote 1's mention of the firm's own April 2023 voluntary recall is historical background, not an FDA-raised recall/withdrawal request, so recall_concern is false. No FEI/location_contains since this is a website review only.
